entries.name: Narrow bridge
entries.description: Bridge narrower than the approach carriageway.

entries.name: Damaged bridge surface
entries.description: Potholes, exposed reinforcement or broken deck surface on a bridge.

entries.name: Broken bridge parapet
entries.description: Missing or broken bridge railing or parapet.

entries.name: Damaged expansion joint
entries.description: Expansion joint with gaps or protruding plates.

entries.name: Tunnel lighting failure
entries.description: Tunnel with lighting out of service.

entries.name: Steep bridge approach
entries.description: Hump-backed or steep approach that hides the road beyond.

entries.name: Damaged flyover joint
entries.description: Damaged joint on an elevated road.

entries.name: Flooded underpass
entries.description: Underpass with standing water of unknown depth.

entries.name: Railway crossing damage
entries.description: Broken surface between rails at a level crossing.

entries.name: Unprotected embankment
entries.description: Embankment at a bridge approach without barrier.

entries.name: Landslide
entries.description: Slope failure depositing material on, or removing, the road.

entries.name: Road collapse
entries.description: Section of carriageway collapsed or washed away.

entries.name: Retaining wall damage
entries.description: Cracked or bulging retaining wall beside the road.
